## Context / Problem
usage-log rows (src/rebar/llm/usage_log.py) record the four token fields but not model, provider, or timestamp, and the plan-review budget shedder prices work with hard-coded guesses (COST_SINGLE_TURN_USD=0.006, COST_AGENT_USD=0.12, src/rebar/llm/plan_review/sizing.py:107-109). No provider publishes a machine-readable price API; pydantic's genai-prices package bundles offline price data with cache read/write tiers, historical prices by timestamp, and a typed LookupError for unknown models — and pydantic-ai's RequestUsage already implements its AbstractUsage protocol. Operator approved it as an optional add-in with graceful fallback.

## Approach
(1) Extend usage_log.record to record(usage, *, op, model=None, provider=None) plus a UTC ISO timestamp written inside record(); update its single call site at runner.py:547 to pass model=ran_model and the provider inferred by the existing mapping at src/rebar/llm/config.py:321-327. (2) summarize keeps its existing grouping by op and adds cost: per-row cost is computed from that row's own model/provider/timestamp, so a multi-model op sums correctly row by row; the report prints per-op est. cost plus a per-model rollup table. (3) Pricing is attempted only when `import genai_prices` succeeds; each row's calc_price call is wrapped in `except Exception` (pricing must never break summarize): LookupError marks the row unpriced, any other exception is logged at WARNING and the row is marked unpriced; the summary reports "excludes N unpriced calls". When the package is absent, summarize prints token totals with the cost column reading "unavailable (install rebar[pricing])". (4) New optional extra `pricing = ["genai-prices"]` in pyproject.toml. Never a hard error, never a silently-wrong number; the column is labeled "est. cost". Alternative rejected: vendoring LiteLLM's ~2 MB price JSON — takes on key-normalization and schema-drift ownership that genai-prices maintains upstream.

## Scope
src/rebar/llm/usage_log.py, src/rebar/llm/runner.py (record call site), pyproject.toml, tests/unit/test_usage_log.py (extend), docs/llm-framework.md (usage-log section).

## Testing
Unit: rows gain the three new fields via the updated record signature; summarize with a stubbed genai_prices prices known rows, marks unknown-model rows unpriced via LookupError, marks a malformed-row pricing crash unpriced via the broad handler with a WARNING log, and totals annotate the exclusion; summarize with the import failing prints the unavailable message and exits 0; old-format rows without the new fields still summarize.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] New usage-log rows carry model, provider, and UTC timestamp, populated from the runner call site (checked: `pytest tests/unit/test_usage_log.py`).
- [ ] With genai-prices importable, summarize prints per-op est. cost and a per-model rollup, marking unknown or crash rows unpriced without raising (checked: unit tests with a stubbed price module covering LookupError and a generic exception).
- [ ] Without genai-prices, summarize prints token totals and "unavailable (install rebar[pricing])" and exits 0 (checked: unit test with import blocked).
- [ ] Rows written by the previous format still summarize without error (checked: fixture test).
